title: YouTube says it is adjusting its Shorts recommendations to prioritize "original content" and reduce the reach of channels re-uploading others' content (Andrew Romero/9to5Google)
summary: Andrew Romero / 9to5Google: YouTube says it is adjusting its Shorts recommendations to prioritize “original content” and reduce the reach of channels re-uploading others' content — YouTube says it wants to ‘focus on originality’ in a push to surface better Shorts recommendations for users.
contentText:
Andrew Romero / 9to5Google :

YouTube says it is adjusting its Shorts recommendations to prioritize “original content” and reduce the reach of channels re-uploading others' content   —  YouTube says it wants to ‘focus on originality’ in a push to surface better Shorts recommendations for users.
